'''Goh's Pyukumuku''' (Japanese: '''ゴウのナマコブシ''' ''Go's Namakobushi'') is the first {{OBP|Pokémon|species}} that [[Goh]] {{pkmn2|caught}} in the [[Alola]] [[region]], and his sixty-third overall.

==History==
==={{aniseries|JN}}===
[[File:Goh Pyukumuku and Magikarp.png|250px|left|thumb|Pyukumuku with Magikarp]]
{{p|Pyukumuku}} was caught in ''[[JN037|That New Old Gang of Mine!]]'' while Goh and {{Ash}} were exploring [[Melemele Island]]. Later, Pyukumuku was seen being greeted by [[Goh's giant Magikarp]] at [[Cerise Laboratory]].

In ''[[JN076|All Out, All of the Time!]]'', Pyukumuku was used by [[Goh]] to battle a {{p|Bruxish}} that he needed to catch during the [[Pokémon Catch Adventure Race]]. Using its {{m|Toxic}} to weaken the {{type|Water}} Pokémon, Goh successfully caught it.

In ''[[JN107|Big Brother to the Rescue!]]'', Pyukumuku became frustrated with the polluted water stream in [[Cerise Laboratory|Cerise Park]] after it was forced to abandon its favorite spot, and began spreading its slime all over the area to display its unhappiness. However, after the source of the pollution was found, and the water stream was cleared by {{TP|Goh|Suicune}}, Pyukumuku returned to its favorite spot in the park.

In ''[[JN135|Heroes Unite!]]'', Pyukumuku joined the rest of Goh's Pokémon at the lab to celebrate their Trainer's return from the last mission of [[Project Mew]]. In ''[[JN136|This Could be the Start of Something Big!]]'', it attended a surprise party hosted by the Lab members commemorating Goh and Ash's departure.

==Personality and characteristics==
Pyukumuku is quite lonely and reserved, preferring to remain alone in whatever spot it chooses. Despite this, Pyukumuku is loyal towards Goh, following every command without question. Common to its species, Pyukumuku hates being forced out of its favorite spot, and often displays its unhappiness by spraying its slime all over the area. It is also shown to dislike being poked, as seen when it punched [[Goh's Raboot]] for doing so.
